# Summary

Describe the user visible result and the reason for the change.

# Validation

1. [ ] pnpm typecheck passes.
2. [ ] pnpm test passes.
3. [ ] pnpm build passes.
4. [ ] Fixtures and examples are synthetic.
5. [ ] No provider authentication artifact is mutated.
6. [ ] New prose follows the project prose rule.

# Connector honesty

State any interface status, drift risk, credential origin, automation risk, and egress change. Write not applicable when no connector changes.
